text.p: Interpoint Corp on Friday said shareholders approved the company's pending merger with a subsidiary of Crane Co.

In a statement the company said it expects the previously-announced spin off its Advanced Digital Information Corp subsidiary and the subsequent merger of the Interpoint microelectronics business with the Crane unit will occur on October 16.

Further, the company said that shares of ADIC, which will be distributed to shareholders of Interpoint immediately prior to the effective time of the merger, are expected to begin trading October 16 or 17 on the Nasdaq National Market System under the symbol. Interpoint shares will continue to trade until the completion of the merger.
